body.x: Mars Auto (CEO il-su Park) participated in the 'Startup Zone' at the Eureka Park K-STARTUP integrated hall of 'CES 2023' in Las Vegas, USA from January 5 (Thursday) to 8 (Sunday, local time) for a total of 4 days.

Established in 2017, Mars Auto is a company that developed ‘Mars Pilot’, an autonomous driving system designed for trucks with the vision of complete automation of transportation in logistics centers.

The company explained that Mars Pilot is an autonomous driving system that is installed on the cabs on truck chassis, and simultaneously achieves stable autonomous driving and out-standing unit economics. From the machine learning pipeline to the hardware design, all of the elements of Mars Pilot are centered on stability and scalability.

The respective system uses the 4 external cameras mounted on the chassis, cab and the 3 internal cameras installed in the cabin to collect 2D sequential images, which the autonomous driving software reconstitutes into 3D vector spaces to make decisions needed for driving, and finally, it relays accurate steering/ driving information to the actuator to make the truck drive smoothly. Mars Pilot, which performs level 3 autonomous driving in an average of 97% of customer cargo routes, won the CES 2023 Innovation Award in the ‘Vehicle Tech and Advanced Mobility’ category.

An official of Mars Auto said that, “Mars Pilot was developed to dominate the global freight transportation market with cutting-edge autonomous truck driving performance that is perfect for the area of driving design and outstanding unit economics,” and explained that, “With its competitiveness from excellent software, Mars Pilot is not only capable of performing 500-mile transportations without any intervention from a vehicle operator, it is also 15% more fuel efficient than the average human driver. The efficient software can be realized with a system cost that is only 20% compared to competitors and with 15W batteries that are originally installed in the truck.”

They went on to say, “Mars Pilot installed on fully loaded class 7 trucks transported freight every day from 2020, covering over 200,000 miles, and never had a single accident. On October 2022, Mars Auto commercialized the safe and cost-efficient Mars Pilot in Korea, and attracted investments from Silicon Valley VCs like YCombinator, Soma Capital, and GFT Ventures, as well as major VCs from Korea, such as Mirae Asset Venture Investment and Kakao Ventures.”

Mars Auto established Mars Logis, an autonomous trucking company, in April 2022, and provides transportation services with 5 trucks equipped with Mars Pilot. The official explained that Korea’s biggest retailers, logistics service companies, and leading freight platforms use Mars Logis’ Mars Pilot-equipped truck fleets every day.

The official shared their aspirations, saying, “Our company’s next goal is to undertake a pilot freight program in the US, and we seek to use CES 2023 as leverage for our US partnerships,” and said that, “In 2023, Mars Logis will expand their autonomous truck fleets to 15 vehicles targeting fixed/ regular routes for major logistics companies in Korea. It will also begin a pilot program with class 8 semi-trucks on US transcontinental highways, beginning in the second half of 2023.”

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.

The K-STARTUP Joint Pavilion featured joint participation of institutions like the Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development, Seoul Business Agency, and Seoul Digital Foundation, as well as 51 Korean innovative companies, to enter the US market and discover global partners. In addition, university student supporters of CES 2023 chosen by each university (Kyunghee, Kookmin, Sogang, Chung-Ang) matched to participating companies based on their respective majors and fields of business.
